source: Jira project SMF (answersllc.atlassian.net); Jira descriptions are authoritative
note: Specifications only. No execution results are recorded here; see evidence/. test_users, test_data, case spec (expected outcome) and required_evidence are quoted verbatim from the snapshot; persona_refs/fixture_refs are extracted logical IDs defined in testing/contract.json. Personas and fixtures are specifications, not proof that accounts or data exist.

Deny restricted/wrong-case room and asset access; test revoked access and document the actual enforcement timing.
Run desktop↔physical mobile pairs and verify final Salesforce snapshot/version association. Record missed targets as FAIL/PARTIAL, not hidden exceptions.
